belay.1: Stop once the pitch reaches the crest of the ridge, and set up the belay there.
belay.2: After traversing the sharp ridge from the first gendarme, downclimb into the notch at its far end and anchor there.
belay.3: Go around the second gendarme on its right, then climb straight up to the ridge, where a big slung boulder serves as the belay.
belay.4: The belay is at a large boulder around the corner from the notch past the knife-edge, backed by a cordelette looped around it.
belay.5: Belay from a sling at the foot of the final vertical rock, at the end of the long exposed walking traverse.
